name: Collapsing Ramp (9-10)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-22: Breaking the Storm: Excising Ruination
description: Abyssal fire hits the stone beneath the ramp, causing a 15-foot-long section of it to collapse.
disable: DC 31 Crafting (expert) to stabilize the masonry. Each attempt takes 2 actions.

generalAbilities.name: Collapse
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks onto the collapse site

Effect The triggering creature falls off the Colossus and lands on the ground, taking 50 Bludgeoning Damage damage. They can use the Grab an Edge reaction to avoid falling (DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw save).
